Claire (People Ops): Hi team — quick drop of compact OKR + self-review templates for the upcoming performance cycle. plz review; aim to keep 1–3 measurable OKRs and a short self-review. will iterate based on feedback.

Claire (People Ops): Suggested OKR format (copy/paste):
```
Objective: Improve inference platform reliability
KR1: Reduce P99 latency for /generate by 20%
KR2: Decrease incident MTTR from 45m -> 25m
KR3: Increase automated e2e coverage from 55% -> 80%
Owner: @your-name
Target date: 2026-06-30
```

Claire (People Ops): Self-review template (short):
```
1) What I set out to do (1-2 lines)
2) What I shipped / results (metrics or outcomes)
3) Challenges and how I addressed them
4) 2 areas to improve next cycle
5) Any feedback for manager / org
```

Claire (People Ops): Manager guidance snippet:
```
- Keep 15–30 min 1:1 for goal alignment
- Ask for concrete examples, metrics
- Prioritize development & stretch goals + safety nets
- Give actionable feedback, link to company values
```

Mike (EM): Love the short formats. Can we add an example for support/ops where metrics are incident-related?

Claire (People Ops): Good call — will add a support example. Draft below:
```
Objective: Strengthen on-call maturity
KR1: Reduce after-hours incidents by 30% via runbook automations
KR2: Implement 3 runbook automations for top incident types
KR3: Document post-incident review process and ensure 100% RCA within 7 days
```

Anjali (Product): Quick note — for product KRs, include a qualitative adoption metric like "% of teams using feature X" alongside usage numbers.

Josh (Eng): minor nit: prefer "MTTR" spelled out once + (MTTR) the first time in templates for clarity for new hires.

Lisa (Manager): Thumbs up. Could we add a one-line coaching prompt managers can paste in review invites? e.g., "Please use the short self-review template and add 1 example where you learned something." 

Claire (People Ops): Yes — will add. Also thinking of a one-page manager checklist and a slide to drop into team meetings.

hr-bot: Reminder: Performance cycle opens 2026-04-01. Templates will be pinned to #people-ops and the handbook.

Mike (EM): Sounds great — thanks Claire. I'll pilot with my team next week and report back.

Anjali (Product): +1 to piloting. If anyone wants to co-write product examples, ping me.

Claire (People Ops): THANKS all. I'll update the doc and post final pinned versions by EOD Friday. :pray:
